company.shortDescription: Chart is a mobile platform that helps commuters optimize their commuter benefits and make money on their way to work.
company.description:
Chart is a mobile platform that offers commuters a way optimize their transportation benefits and make money on their way to work. Chat also gives companies ROI and utilization analytics for their sponsored commuter benefits.

Chart was founded by Johnny Chan and Christopher Haire in 2015. The company is based in San Francisco, California.
